description:
Mirrors GitHub issue #30 (https://github.com/theodoreOnzGit/outram-park-backend/issues/30). Maintainer-specified overhaul of kovan's GUI surface, spread across the issue body + 2 comments (2026-08-21). This is scoping only -- FILED, NOT IMPLEMENTED, per explicit maintainer instruction ('don't construct yet, just file beans').

CURRENT STATE (surveyed 2026-08-21, before filing): kovan-gui (crates/kovan/src/bin/kovan-gui.rs) is a thin wrapper around kovan_literature::digitiser::gui::run -- a standalone graph digitiser that takes one CLI-arg image path, no file picker, no theming, no PDF awareness at all. kovan-literature has PDF *text/metadata* extraction (pdf-extract, lopdf) but NO page rasterisation/rendering -- there is no way to display a PDF page as an image today. kovan-literature/src/bibtex.rs already renders a BibTeX entry from one KovanDocument (used by 'kovan lit bibtex'), but there is no aggregate .bib-file management, no bibliography window, and no 'project folder' concept beyond this workspace's own internal open/proprietary/generated archive layout (docs/kovan.md 'Storage Layout'), which is a different, narrower thing than what this issue asks for.

THE FOUR THREADS FROM THE ISSUE:
1. File picker (issue body, point 1) -- kovan-gui has none today.
2. Integrated PDF reader with draw-box-then-right-click digitise, for both plots (existing digitiser engine) and tables (NEW: OCR) (issue body point 2 + first comment) -- needs PDF page rendering, which does not exist in this crate at all today. This is the single largest new capability the issue asks for.
3. Gruvbox theming matching tampines-steam-tables-gui (issue body point 3) -- kovan-gui has zero theming today; tampines-steam-tables-gui's theme.rs (crates/tampines-steam-tables/examples/tampines-steam-tables-gui/theme.rs) already carries a Gruvbox Dark/Light palette with morhetz/gruvbox MIT attribution -- reuse that provenance, don't re-derive it.
4. BibTeX-from-open-PDF + a JabRef-like bibliography window + a whole new 'kovan folder' project format (kovan.toml index + user-named .bib + pdf/ + markdown/, with markdown files in a STANDARD section structure that kovan.toml indexes down to line numbers, auto-regenerated by kovan on change; GUI can edit content but not structure) (second comment) -- this is architecturally the biggest single piece, on par with the rest of the issue combined, and needs a design pass before any code.

RECONCILE WITH EXISTING DESIGN RULE: docs/kovan.md 'Canonical Representation' says 'Only the Rust struct is authoritative... Do not make: BibTeX, TOML, Markdown metadata authoritative.' The new kovan.toml the maintainer wants must be a GENERATED index (regenerated from the Rust KovanDocument struct + markdown structure, like CATALOGUE.md already is for the internal archive), never hand-authored source of truth -- this needs to be explicit in the design bead (30.10) so implementation doesn't quietly violate the existing rule.

Child issues break this into: 2 standalone decisions (PDF rendering engine choice; OCR tooling/policy), a design pass for the project-folder format, and the GUI/lib deliverables that depend on them. See children for the dependency graph -- it is NOT a flat list, several items block others.
